description: Move one task to a named column, for example "In Progress" or "Done". Takes the task id, not a Trello card id. A task that was archived is brought back when it is moved. When you tell a person what you moved, name the task by its Title rather than its id.

board.description: Board name or id. Omit when one is configured.

list.description: The column to move it to, as named in "columns".

task_id.description: The Task ID, as list_tasks reports it.

name: move_task
title: Move a task to a column
